title: EDR_T3 re-level — Phase-A re-gate (complete method: level + yaw + AOI)
bright_line: leveling from OUR vetted markers; reference gate-only.
method_applied: robust scale-bar-MAD outlier rejection (auto-excluded 25/26) -> vetted-6 plane normal->Z (roll+pitch); yaw-align 14-20 midline||X (+4.19 deg); center midline midpoint->origin; AOI crop dense cloud to 10x1x5 m (17.52M->7.92M); rebuild DEM+ortho via run_pipeline.py.

PASS_metrics.note_tilt: down from 24.26; long-axis flat; within accepted 2-4 deg envelope (marker Y-spread 0.85m floor).

FAIL_metric.cause: AOI mis-placed relative to the actual dense reef band. The reef footprint is a wedge: Y-center drifts +0.98 m (X=0) -> +0.49 m (X=9.5) and the band PCA major-axis is -3.03 deg off the X-grid. The AOI was centered/aligned to the 14-20 marker midline (Y=0, 0 deg), but markers 14/20 sit ~0.75 m to one side of the reef band AND ~3 deg angled to it. So the 1 m crop clips a diagonal/offset reef band -> 48% fill.
FAIL_metric.key_insight: Markers define the LEVEL PLANE well (substrate normal); they do NOT define the AOI position/heading (14/20 are off-center and angled vs the reef strip).

verdict: LEVELING VALIDATED (tilt 24.26->~2-4, roughness matches ref, co-reg dx=dy=0, scale exact). PRODUCT GATE FAILS on coverage due to AOI placement from markers instead of from the dense reef footprint.
recommended_fix: Keep leveling (roll+pitch) from vetted markers. Derive the AOI from the DENSE CLOUD footprint instead of the 2 markers: yaw-align to the cloud footprint PCA major axis (~-3 deg correction) and center the 10x1 AOI on the cloud centroid (Y ~ +0.75 m shift), then re-crop + re-gate. Predicted coverage ~97%. Still 100% our-data; reference stays gate-only.
do_not: register to reference; chase sub-2 deg cross; codify (Phase B) until AOI fix gates.

phaseA2_footprint_framed_result.verdict: PASS — full product gate met after footprint-derived AOI placement.
phaseA2_footprint_framed_result.method_delta: leveling (roll+pitch) from vetted markers UNCHANGED; AOI yaw from dense-footprint PCA major axis (-2.03 deg) + center from footprint centroid (NOT the 2 markers); 10x1 crop (17.52M->16.11M).
